This is a hands-on regional/global role with ownership across core C&B activities, job architecture, benchmarking, RSU administration and reward governance. The role will also help standardise programmes and processes as the organisation continues to scale internationally. The position will manage a small team covering HRIS and RSU administration and work closely with HR, Finance, Legal and business leaders across different countries. Key Responsibilities: Compensation & Benefits Manage annual compensation cycles including salary review, increments, bonus planning and related analysis. Conduct salary benchmarking and provide market data to support hiring, retention and internal pay decisions. Review and improve compensation structures across different markets. Support the standardisation of employee benefits, including medical insurance and other core benefit programmes. Ensure reward practices remain practical, competitive and aligned with business needs. Job Architecture Build and maintain a consistent global job architecture, including job levels, titles and role structures. Review existing titles and levels and help bring greater consistency across functions and countries. Support HR and business leaders on role levelling and internal equity. RSU & Equity Programmes Own the administration and ongoing improvement of the company’s RSU programme. Coordinate annual grants, vesting schedules and employee communications. Work with external platform providers and internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely administration. Review existing processes and identify opportunities to improve governance, controls and employee experience. Support the development of future executive reward and equity programmes where required. Reward Governance Establish clear controls and approval processes for compensation and equity-related activities. Support reward governance required for a listed-company environment. Prepare analysis, materials and documentation for senior management and future Remuneration Committee discussions. Work closely with Finance, Legal and HR to ensure reward programmes are properly documented and administered. HR Systems & Team Management Manage team members responsible for HRIS and RSU administration. Oversee HRIS-related reward data and processes, currently supported through Zoho People. Improve data quality, reporting and process consistency across markets. Support future HR platform or process changes where required. Candidate Profile Around 10–15 years of experience in Compensation & Benefits, Total Rewards or a closely related HR discipline. Strong hands-on experience in compensation review, salary benchmarking, bonus planning and benefits. Practical experience with job architecture, job levelling and title structures. Direct experience administering RSU, equity or long-term incentive programmes is essential. Experience working in a regional or global organisation with multiple countries. Comfortable working with HRIS and reward-related data. Experience in a listed company or environment with stronger governance requirements would be useful. Able to work across HR, Finance, Legal and senior business stakeholders. Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to improve existing processes rather than only operate established programmes. Comfortable working in a growing organisation where some structures and processes still need to be built or standardised. Strong English communication and stakeholder management skills. What Success Looks Like The successful person will bring stronger structure and consistency to the company’s global reward practices, improve job and pay governance, strengthen RSU administration, and build a more scalable Total Rewards framework as the organisation continues to grow internationally.

review_candidates.description: Company Description HAS International is a Wyoming-based holding company overseeing a vertically integrated, family-owned textile group with over 50 years of heritage. The company connects North American charitable surplus with global industrial demand through a circular ecosystem that supports U.S. non-profits, empowers manufacturers in Asia, and supplies high-quality materials worldwide. Its Circular Threads division focuses on ethical salvage textiles, purchasing large volumes of mixed rags and related products from major charities across the U.S. and Asia-Pacific, then exporting to owned facilities in Pakistan, India, and the Middle East. HAS Trading sources precision yarns from reputable mills across Asia, while Super Knits manufactures premium apparel fabrics with full control from yarn sourcing to knitting and dyeing. Together, these pillars provide reliable supply chains and sustainable textile solutions to markets in Africa and beyond. Role Description This full-time Sales and Marketing Specialist role is based in Karāchi and follows a hybrid work model, combining on-site collaboration with some work-from-home flexibility. The specialist will support sales growth across HAS International’s textile divisions by identifying new business opportunities, nurturing existing client relationships, and coordinating with international partners and internal teams. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing sales pipelines, preparing proposals and quotations, conducting market and competitor research, and assisting in the development and execution of sales and marketing campaigns. The role also involves delivering product presentations, supporting customer onboarding and training, responding to inquiries, and ensuring a high standard of customer service throughout the sales cycle. The specialist will collaborate closely with sales management to track performance metrics, refine strategies, and contribute to long-term business development initiatives. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with clients, partners, and internal teams. Candidates should possess Sales and Sales Management skills to drive revenue, manage pipelines, and support long-term account growth. Candidates should possess Training skills to support client onboarding, product demonstrations, and internal knowledge sharing. Relevant experience in B2B sales, textiles, manufacturing, or international trade is beneficial. Proficiency with CRM tools, spreadsheets, and presentation software, along with strong organizational and analytical abilities. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment in Karāchi, including occasional travel to local partners or facilities.

review_candidates.title: Regional Sales Manager (Spray Drying/Industrial)
review_candidates.description: Key Responsibilities: Regional Sales & Business Development Develop and execute regional sales strategies to achieve revenue, margin, and growth targets for spray drying solutions. Identify and develop new business opportunities across food, dairy, nutrition, ingredients, and other relevant processing industries. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline covering new projects, plant expansions, upgrades, and replacement opportunities. Conduct market mapping and identify high-potential customers, applications, industries, and geographic opportunities. Develop new accounts while strengthening relationships with existing customers and strategic partners. Solution & Technical Sales Understand customer production requirements and work closely with technical teams to develop suitable spray drying and processing solutions. Engage customers at an early stage of project development to understand technical, commercial, and operational requirements. Present equipment capabilities, technical solutions, project concepts, and value propositions to customers and key decision-makers. Coordinate technical discussions, site visits, trials, demonstrations, and feasibility assessments where required. Translate customer requirements into commercially viable technical proposals. Project & Capital Equipment Sales Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation and opportunity qualification through quotation, negotiation, project award, and handover. Prepare and coordinate commercial proposals, quotations, tenders, and technical submissions with internal engineering and project teams. Lead commercial negotiations covering pricing, specifications, delivery timelines, payment terms, and contractual requirements. Monitor project progress and maintain regular communication with customers throughout the sales and execution process. Ensure smooth handover of awarded projects to project execution and service teams. Key Account & Stakeholder Management Develop long-term relationships with key customers, including senior management, plant managers, engineering teams, procurement, R&D, and technical decision-makers. Act as a trusted advisor by understanding customers' production challenges and identifying opportunities for process improvement or expansion. Manage strategic accounts and identify opportunities for additional equipment, upgrades, replacement systems, and aftermarket services. Maintain strong relationships with distributors, agents, consultants, and other business partners across the region. Market & Competitor Intelligence Monitor market trends, customer investments, competitor activities, technology developments, and industry developments. Gather market intelligence and provide feedback to management and product/technical teams. Identify emerging applications and industries where spray drying technology can provide value. Monitor upcoming projects and capital investment plans to build a strong future sales pipeline. Distributor & Channel Management Develop and manage regional distributors, agents, and business partners where applicable. Establish clear sales objectives and support channel partners in identifying and developing opportunities. Provide product, application, and commercial support to distributors to strengthen their ability to sell the solutions. Monitor channel performance and identify opportunities to expand market coverage. Forecasting & Reporting Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports, opportunity tracking, and territory plans. Monitor performance against sales targets, margins, and key commercial KPIs. Provide regular updates to management on pipeline development, major opportunities, market trends, and risks. Ensure CRM and sales management systems are consistently updated. Regional Collaboration Work closely with Engineering, Application, Project Management, Service, Product Management, and other internal teams to deliver effective customer solutions. Collaborate with regional and global teams on major opportunities and strategic accounts. Represent the organisation at industry exhibitions, conferences, seminars, customer events, and technical workshops. Travel extensively across the assigned region to meet customers, visit sites, and develop new business opportunities. Requirements Job Requirements: Education & Experience Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Food Technology, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline . Minimum 7–10 years of experience in technical sales, capital equipment sales, process equipment, or industrial solutions. Experience selling spray drying, food processing, dairy processing, powder processing, or related process technology will be highly advantageous. Strong experience in B2B solution selling and project-based capital equipment sales . Experience managing regional markets and working with customers across multiple countries is preferred. Proven track record of achieving sales targets and developing new business opportunities. Industry & Technical Knowledge Strong understanding of industrial processing environments and equipment-based solutions. Knowledge of spray drying technology and applications within food, dairy, nutrition, ingredients, chemicals, or related industries would be a strong advantage. Ability to understand technical specifications and translate customer requirements into appropriate solutions. Familiarity with engineering, manufacturing, plant operations, and project execution processes. Experience working with OEMs, system integrators, engineering consultants, distributors, or industrial end-users is advantageous. Commercial & Sales Skills Strong business development and consultative selling capabilities. Excellent negotiation and commercial management skills. Strong understanding of long sales cycles, capital expenditure projects, tender processes, and solution-based selling. Ability to develop relationships with both technical and senior commercial decision-makers. Strong sales forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM discipline. Commercially driven with a strong understanding of margins and project profitability. Leadership & Personal Attributes Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Consultative and customer-focused approach with the ability to understand complex technical requirements. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and comfortable working independently across a regional territory. Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and commercial teams. Results-oriented with strong ownership of sales targets and business development activities. Willingness to travel extensively across the region as required.
